name: Speech and Language UK — support for adults with DLD
description: A Speech and Language UK page collecting information, communities and assessment or support routes for adults with Developmental Language Disorder.
intended_use: Find adult-focused DLD information and routes to further assessment, professional directories, communities or practical support.
audience_or_context: Adults with DLD or people exploring adult DLD support, plus families and professionals helping them find current routes.
limitations: The page aggregates several external routes whose availability, eligibility and costs can change.
It is an information and signposting page rather than proof that a particular assessment or support option will suit an individual.
cost_or_access_notes: The information page is publicly accessible; external assessment or professional services listed from it may have their own fees or eligibility conditions.
conflicts_of_interest: The page is maintained by Speech and Language UK and includes links to external providers; ND Oracle records the route without endorsing those providers.

provenance.method: Speech and Language UK's current adult DLD support page checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records the information/signposting function and explicit cost/availability uncertainty without adding efficacy claims.
